prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website hero composition study, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design a premium Flevio web agency desktop hero called “Live Type Atelier.” This is a real website UI mockup, not a poster. Preserve the existing floating header silhouette: top-left black rounded-square logo and EN/KA language pill, tiny centered FLEVIO wordmark, top-right white Menu pill. Do not redesign the header.
Structure: full-viewport warm-white working surface. Oversized asymmetric three-line headline dominates the middle-left: “WE BUILD” / “WEBSITES” / “THAT CONVERT”. The word WEBSITES shows a restrained technical selection frame with dashed construction detail on one or two letters, implying pointer interaction. A concise value paragraph sits in the lower-left: “Custom websites shaped around your business, designed to earn trust and turn attention into action.” A prominent cherry-red “CONTACT US” control anchors the lower center-left. A quiet lower-right note reads “CUSTOM DESIGN · HAND-CODED DEVELOPMENT”.
Visual system: supplied background translated into warm white: subtle radial depth, broad diagonal skewed Cherry Red light streaks masked into fading bands, faint 20px dot field, no remote photo texture. Editorial negative space, precise alignment, technical craft, premium confidence, experimental but conversion-clear.
Color palette: Warm White #EFEDE6 dominant, Cherry Red #CD0000 signature, near-black #151412 text.
Typography: ownable wide grotesk display character, huge but readable, tight tracking no more than -0.04em; restrained sans for supporting copy.
Motion cue: only through the selected-letter construction frame and drifting red light bands; do not add unrelated 3D objects.
Constraints: desktop hero only; no cards, no gradient text, no glassmorphism, no orange, no geographic trust claim, no fake awards, counts, reviews, logos, or client claims. Exact headline and CTA text must be legible. Show only enough of the next section as a thin edge at the bottom.
